instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Archicad graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal, Command Prompt, or PowerShell; do not run Python, shell, IfcOpenShell, Archicad API, scripts, macros, or any helper automation that directly generates or edits the deliverable file. Use only Archicad native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, palettes, element settings, and built-in save/export commands. Add Doors to Corridor Plan. Start from the provided init.ifc by opening it in Archicad. The init model is a relevant but incomplete predecessor; clean, complete, rename, subdivide, or add BIM elements as requested instead of replacing it with unrelated geometry. Build or edit the model using real Archicad BIM elements such as Walls, Slabs, Zones, Doors, Windows, Roofs, and Stairs where required; use real BIM elements rather than visual-only detail geometry where the task requires model elements. Save the only required deliverable on the Desktop as C:\Users\user\Desktop\result.ifc using Archicad's built-in IFC export or Save As IFC workflow. Export the complete model as IFC4 and include the Zones/Spaces in the export. The init model contains a corridor and two rooms but the openings are incomplete. Add real doors so CORRIDOR, ROOM 1, and ROOM 2 are connected as a usable small plan; include at least two windows. The exported IFC should contain Zones exported as IfcSpace entries named CORRIDOR, ROOM 1, ROOM 2. It should contain at least 1 building storey, at least 3 IfcSpace zones, at least 7 wall-like IfcWall or IfcWallStandardCase elements, at least 1 IfcSlab element, at least 3 IfcDoor elements, at least 2 IfcWindow elements. The shaped model should have an overall size roughly matching X span 12 m, Y span 5 m, and Z span 3 m. The IFC should have unique GlobalId values for IfcRoot objects. Other exact coordinates, room proportions, wall thicknesses, opening positions, materials, library part names, property sets, layers, relationship nesting, and harmless exporter metadata may vary as long as the saved result.ifc satisfies the stated BIM content.
